gloss: water receiving tank; water storage tank

definitions.explanation: A tank that receives and stores water from the mains before it is pumped up to a building's upper floors. Common in apartment buildings, schools, and other large facilities.

examples.japanese: {受水槽|じゅすいそう}を{掃除|そうじ}する。
ビルの{屋上|おくじょう}に{大|おお}きな{受水槽|じゅすいそう}がある。
examples.english: There is a large water tank on the roof of the building.

examples.japanese: {受水槽|じゅすいそう}は{年|ねん}に{一回|いっかい}の{点検|てんけん}が{義務|ぎむ}づけられている。
examples.english: Water receiving tanks are required to be inspected once a year.

notes:
Part of a building's water-supply system; subject to legally mandated cleaning and inspection in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受水槽|じゅすいそう}の{清掃|せいそう}: cleaning of the water tank
- {受水槽|じゅすいそう}の{点検|てんけん}: inspection of the water tank
- {受水槽|じゅすいそう}に{水|みず}をためる: to store water in the tank

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {高架水槽|こうかすいそう}: elevated tank — set on the roof, supplying water by gravity
- {貯水槽|ちょすいそう}: cistern — a general term covering any water-storage tank
